<script crossorigin="anonymous" integrity="sha384-B0UglyR+jN6CkvvICOB2joaf5I4l3gm9GU6Hc1og6Ls7i6U/mkkaduKaBhlAXv9k" src="https://stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/4.2.1/js/bootstrap.min.js"></script>
<script>

/* Cookie functions */
function setCookie(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
    if (!exdays) {
      exdays = 365;
    }
    var d = new Date();
    d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
    var expires = "expires="+d.toUTCString();
    document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
}

function getCookie(cname) {
    var name = cname + "=";
    var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for(var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
        var c = ca[i];
        while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
            c = c.substring(1);
        }
        if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
            return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
        }
    }
    return "";
}

function deleteCookie(cname) {
    var expires = "expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC";
    document.cookie = cname + "=;" + expires + ";path=/";
}

/* End of Cookie functions */
</script>

        function mapAdjustment(){

            //Move pointers
            function setDimentions(selector, dimentions, ratio){
                if (selector.indexOf('txt') > -1) {
                    $(selector).attr('x', dimentions.x * ratio);
                    $(selector).attr('y', dimentions.y * ratio);
                    if (selector === '#svg_txt_telaviv') {
                        $(selector).attr('x', dimentions.x * ratio - 50);
                        $(selector).attr('y', dimentions.y * ratio + 10);
                    }
                    if (selector === '#svg_txt_fremont') {
                        $(selector).attr('x', dimentions.x * ratio);
                        $(selector).attr('y', dimentions.y * ratio + 10);
                    }
                } else {
                    $(selector).attr('cx', dimentions.cx * ratio);
                    $(selector).attr('cy', dimentions.cy * ratio);
                }
            }

            var initMapWidth = 913;
            var initMapheight = 475;
            var whRatio = (913/475);
            var maxWidth = 950;
            var screenWidth = $(window).width();
            var screenMapRatio = screenWidth/maxWidth;

            if (screenWidth < maxWidth) {
                var currentMapWidth = screenMapRatio*initMapWidth;
                var currentMapHeight = currentMapWidth/whRatio;


            } else {
                var currentMapWidth = initMapWidth;
                var currentMapHeight = currentMapWidth/whRatio;
                screenMapRatio = 1;
            }

            $('.map-svg').width(currentMapWidth);
            $('.map-svg').height(currentMapHeight);

            $('#svg_1').attr('width', currentMapWidth);
            $('#svg_1').attr('height', currentMapHeight);

                $('.map text').attr('font-size', '11');
            } else {
                $('.map text').attr('font-size', '14');

            setDimentions('#svg_hongkong',  svg_hongkong_d, screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_tokyo',     svg_tokyo_d,    screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_singapore', svg_singapore_d,screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_sydney',    svg_sydney_d,   screenMapRatio);


            setDimentions('#svg_txt_fremont',   svg_txt_fremont_d,  screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_toronto',   svg_txt_toronto_d,  screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_nyc',       svg_txt_nyc_d,      screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_london',    svg_txt_london_d,   screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_frankfurt', svg_txt_frankfurt_d,screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_telaviv',   svg_txt_telaviv_d,  screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_delhi',     svg_txt_delhi_d,    screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_hongkong',  svg_txt_hongkong_d, screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_tokyo',     svg_txt_tokyo_d,    screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_singapore', svg_txt_singapore_d,screenMapRatio);
            setDimentions('#svg_txt_sydney',    svg_txt_sydney_d,   screenMapRatio);
        }

        mapAdjustment();
        $(window).resize(function(){

     function uiForAuthUser(userInfo, loginBtnSelector, freeTrialBtnSelector){
        // $('.main-menu').css('margin-top', '-20px');
        $('#menu-item-12262').html('<a style="width: 205px; color: #fff; background-color: #f89c27;" href="https://cloud.seetest.io/index.html#/launchpad">Access your Tests</a>');
        $(loginBtnSelector).css({
            'width': '195px'
        });
        $(loginBtnSelector).html('<a style="width:auto;" href="https://cloud.seetest.io/index.html#/launchpad">Access your Tests</a>');

        $(freeTrialBtnSelector).css({
            'float':'right',
            'box-shadow': 'none',
            'background-color': 'transparent',
            'margin-top': '15px'
        });
        $(freeTrialBtnSelector).html('<img class="user-image" style ="width: 50px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 50%;" src="' + userInfo.picture + '" /> <div class="user-popup"></div>');
        $(freeTrialBtnSelector + ' .user-image').click(function(){
            //user popup window
            setTimeout(function(){
                $('.user-popup').popover({
                    html: true,
                    selector: freeTrialBtnSelector,
                    placement: 'bottom',
                    trigger: 'manual',
                    content: '<img class="user-popup-image" style ="width: 60px;" src="' + userInfo.picture + '" /> <span class="full-name">' + userInfo.full_name.replace("+","&nbsp;") + '</span><div class="user-popup-email">' + userInfo.email + '</div><div class="profile-link-container"><a href="https://accounts.seetest.io/account/info">My Profile</a></div><div class="user-popup-logout btn btn-default btn-sm" style="margin: 10px 0; float: right;">Logout</div>',
                    template: '<div class="popover profile-popover"><div class="arrow"></div><div class="popover-body"></div></div>'
                });

                $('.user-popup').popover('toggle');
                $('.user-popup-logout').click(function(){
                    setCookie('Authorization','',0);
                    window.location.href = "https://accounts.seetest.io/logout";
                });
            }, 10);
        });
     }



     // *** Authorization  ***//
     var auth = window.getCookie('idToken');
     var uinf = window.getCookie('uinf');
     var APP_ID = "mm0pkmlx";
     if (uinf) {
         $('.strip-header').addClass('loggedin');
         var userInfo = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(uinf));
         uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn-inside-mobile', '.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile');
         uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn', '.free-trial-btn');
         var defaultDay = new Date();
         defaultDay.setMonth(defaultDay.getMonth() - 3);
         var createdAt =  (new Date(userInfo.created_at).getTime()/1000) || defaultDay;
         window.intercomSettings = {
             app_id: APP_ID,
             name: userInfo.name,
             email: userInfo.email,
             created_at: createdAt
        };
     } else if (auth) {
            var authData = { data: auth };
            $.post('https://experitest.com/wp-content/themes/experitest/api/auth0/checkUser.php', authData, function(res){
                var response = JSON.parse(res);

                if (response.authorized) {
                    uiForAuthUser(response, '.login-btn-inside-mobile', '.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile');
                    uiForAuthUser(response, '.login-btn', '.free-trial-btn');
                    if  (typeof authHandler !== 'undefined') {
                        authHandler(response);
                    }
                    var createdAt =  (new Date(response.created_at).getTime()/1000) || 1312182000;
                    window.intercomSettings = {
                        app_id: APP_ID,
                        name: response.name,
                        email: response.email,
                        created_at: createdAt
                    };
                } else {
                    $('.strip-header').removeClass('loggedin');
                    console.log('authtoken is not valid');
                    if  (typeof notAuthHandler !== 'undefined') {
                        notAuthHandler(response);
                    }
                }
            });
        } else {
            window.intercomSettings = { app_id: APP_ID};
        }

        $(window).resize(function(){
            $('.user-popup').popover('dispose');
            if (uinf) {
                var userInfo = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(uinf));
                setTimeout(function(){
                    uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn-inside-mobile', '.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile');
                    uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn', '.free-trial-btn');
                }, 100);
            }
        });
    // *** End of Authorization  ***//

            // Mobile Menu

            $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover({
                'html': true,
                'placement': 'bottom',
                'trigger': 'manual',
                'content': `<div class="mobile-popover-menu-inner-container">
                                <ul>
                                    <li class="login-btn-inside-mobile">
                                        <a href="https://accounts.seetest.io/login"><i class="fas fa-unlock"></i> LOGIN</a>
                                    </li>
                                    <li class="custom-green-btn free-trial-btn-inside-mobile">
                                        <a href="/free-trial">FREE TRIAL</a>
                                    </li>
                                    <li class="mobile-menu-dropdown">
                                        <a href="#" >Platform
                                            <span class="menu-triangle-right">&#9654;</span>
                                            <span class="menu-triangle-down">&#9660;</span>
                                        </a>
                                    </li>
                                    <li><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></li>
                                    <li><a href="/support">Support & Integrations</a></li>
                                    <li><a href="/enterprise">Enterprise</a></li>
                                </ul>
                                <div class="mobile-menu-close-icon">&times;</div>
                                <div class="mobile-menu-custom-background"></div>
                            </div>`
        });


        function mobileMenuToggleHandler() {
            //Add class to opened popover
            $('.mobile-popover-menu-inner-container').parent().parent().addClass("mobile-popover-menu");

            //Add some buttons
            mobileMenuAdjustments();

            //Add dropdown handler
            $('.mobile-menu-dropdown').hover(function(){
                $('.menu-triangle-right').hide();
                $('.menu-triangle-down').show();
                $(this).append($(`<ul class="inner-mobile-menu">
                                        <li><a href="/manual-testing-tool-for-mobile-testing/">Live Mobile Testing</a></li>
                                        <li><a href="/mobile-test-automation/">Automated Mobile Testing</a></li>
                                        <li><a href="/cross-browser-testing/">Live Cross Browser Testing</a></li>
                                        <li><a href="/mobile-test-automation/grid-execution-mobile/">Automated Cross Browser Testing</a></li>
                                    </ul>`));
            }, function(){
                $('.menu-triangle-down').hide();
                $('.menu-triangle-right').show();
                $('.inner-mobile-menu').remove();
            }
            );

            $('.mobile-menu-close-icon').click(function(){
                $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover('hide');
                menuState = false;
            });
        }

        var menuState = false;

        $('.menu-toggle-btn').click(function(){
            if (uinf) {
                var userInfo = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(uinf));
                setTimeout(function(){
                    uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn-inside-mobile', '.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile');
                    uiForAuthUser(userInfo, '.login-btn', '.free-trial-btn');
                }, 100);
            }
            if (!menuState) {
                $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover('show');
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (uinf) {
                        $('.mobile-popover-menu').addClass('loggedin');
                    }
                    else {
                        $('.mobile-popover-menu').removeClass('loggedin');
                    }
                });
                menuState = true;
                mobileMenuToggleHandler();
            } else {
                $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover('hide');
                menuState = false;
            }
        });

        $('html').on('click', function(e) {
            if (! $(e.target).hasClass('menu-toggle-btn')) {
                $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover('hide');
                menuState = false;
            }
        });

        function mobileMenuAdjustments() {

            var screenwidth = $(window).innerWidth();
            // console.log(screenwidth);
            if (screenwidth > 1182) {
                $('.menu-toggle-btn').popover('hide');
                menuState = false;
            }

            if (screenwidth > 633)  {
                $('.login-btn-inside-mobile').hide();
            }

            if (screenwidth < 634) {
                //Move login button to drop-down menu
                // console.log('here');
                $('.login-btn-inside-mobile').show();
            }

            if (screenwidth > 483) {
                //Move also free-trial button to drop-down menu
                if (!uinf) {
                    $('.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile').hide();
                } else {
                    $('.free-trial-btn').show();
                    $('.mobile-menu-custom-background').css('height', '90px');
                }
            }

            if (screenwidth < 484) {
                //Move also free-trial button to drop-down menu
                if (!uinf) {
                    $('.free-trial-btn-inside-mobile').show();
                } else {
                    $('.free-trial-btn').show();
                    $('.free-trial-btn').css('display', 'block');
                    $('.mobile-menu-custom-background').css('height', '90px');
                }
            }
        }

        mobileMenuAdjustments();

        $(window).resize(function() {
            mobileMenuAdjustments();
        });

        /* End of Mobile Menu */

    if ((navigator.userAgent.indexOf("Safari") >= 0 && navigator.userAgent.indexOf("Chrome") < 0) || !!navigator.platform.match(/iPhone|iPod|iPad/))
    {
        $('body').addClass("safari");
    }

    });
</script>
